subject: How to upload an external file in shiny on shinyapps.io

messages.author: dd330129cd0c5968
messages.subject: How to upload an external file in shiny on shinyapps.io
parts:
I have created an interface by Rstudio and in server.R I call a external "XXX.exe" file under windows, which uses the inputs on the interface and returns the results, which will display again on the interface. 

When I deploy the shiny app through the rstudio console, the external "XXX.exe" is not uploaded. Interesting is that the help text files (save the inputs and also results of the exe file will be saved on a text file) are uploaded. 

Is it principally possible to bundle the exe file to the application and uploaded on the shinyapps.io?

Thanks in advances for your answers!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to upload an external file in shiny on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi Davood,
shinyapps.io is deployed on Linux, so unfortunately you won't be able to run any .exe files on it.   
Hope this helps.
-Tareef

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How to upload an external file in shiny on shinyapps.io
parts:
I am guessing that you need to set the executable permission on the executable.  Deploying an application doesn't automatically set the permissions for you.

You would need to do something like:

Sys.chmod() to make it executable.  

It would be helpful for me to understand what you are trying to do here, since shinyapps.io is meant to be a platform for running shiny applications and not a general purpose execution platform in the cloud, for which there are much better solutions out there.  :)

Thank you for your helpful comments.

I tried to change the permission inside the shiny (server.R) using the following command:

Sys.chmod("Bedload_Web-Linux.run", mode = "777", use_umask = TRUE)

but now the error in log file is really interesting: 

2016-07-15T06:49:14.583448+00:00 shinyapps[114589]: sh: 1: ./Bedload_Web-Linux.run: not found

without this command it says Permission denied ??????

about what I am trying to do:
I wrote a program which calculate some parameter in a river cross section based on user defined data. I am trying to make it as web application. the Interface using Shiny (based on RStudio) is a interface, which get the data and by pressing a button run the program to calculate (computation kernel) the results and  these results will be displayed on interface too. The external program is written in C++ without any graphical library (standard library).
I want to be sure that it works well on the web before to start to lunch it on platforms, which are not always free of charge.

If you have better suggestion, I am really pleased to have them.

Thank you again :-)
